title: IPM Prevention, Zoning, Intake, and Personnel Control Workbook
purpose: Provide traceable records for IPM prevention priorities, clean-to-dirty workflow, plant intake/quarantine, personnel controls, and crop-contact sanitation.

sections.title: IPM Prevention and Monitoring Plan
sections.decisionPrompt: Is the program acting on prevention and measured trends rather than calendar treatment?

sections.title: Facility Zoning and Movement Map
sections.decisionPrompt: Where can people, tools, carts, plants, or waste carry risk from higher-risk to cleaner zones?

sections.title: Plant Intake and Quarantine Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Is there enough evidence to release incoming plants without exposing established production?

sections.title: Personnel Entry and Clothing Control Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does personnel workflow reduce transfer opportunity while remaining practical and consistently followed?

sections.title: Tool, Bench, and Container Sanitation Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Was visible contamination removed before the sanitation/disinfection step, and was the validated procedure actually followed?

qualityRules: Separate prevention, monitoring, identification, intervention, and verification steps.
Do not infer outbreak source from personnel movement alone.
Use product labels/manufacturer instructions rather than invented disinfectant rates.
Preserve quarantine and release decisions with evidence.
